title: Keyboard shortcut to toggle light/dark theme
line: You can now set a keyboard shortcut that switches between the light and dark Global Theme.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.7 the Brightness and Color widget has a Dark Mode switch, but there was no global shortcut action for it, so switching themes from the keyboard needed third-party tools. The Global Theme auto-switcher (a kded module that always runs) now registers a "Toggle Dark Mode" action under a "Global Theme" category in the Shortcuts settings, with no default key. Pressing it switches to the other default theme (light or dark) the same way the widget's switch does.

commits.message:
kcms/lookandfeel: add a global shortcut to toggle dark mode

Switching between the light and dark Global Themes could only be done in
System Settings or in the Brightness and Color widget. The auto-switcher
now registers a "Toggle Dark Mode" action that works like that toggle.

BUG: 511108
